verdict.rationale: Composio ships a full OpenAPI-documented API, SDK, CLI, and hosted MCP server covering sessions, auth, triggers, and tool execution (composio-docs-1,9,10; composio-probe-2,3,4), suggesting an API-first architecture where most UI-configurable actions (auth, webhooks, toolkits, white-labeling) have API/CLI equivalents. However there's no explicit documentation asserting full 1:1 parity between the dashboard UI and the API, and a community report shows at least one integration (Instagram connect) failing via the API path with a 400 error, suggesting some workflows may not work as smoothly as advertised. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement or audit showing every UI feature (e.g. dashboard analytics, project settings) is API-accessible, and independent confirmation that failures like the Instagram case are edge cases rather than systemic gaps.
